name: epgs
description: 内镜重点患者监测系统 (Endoscopy Key-Patient Monitoring System) - monorepo

scripts.build:libs: pnpm run build:shared-types && pnpm run build:matching-engine && pnpm run build:ai-semantic && pnpm run build:notification-push
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:libs && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter api run start:dev" "cross-env PORT=3001 pnpm --filter worker run start:dev" "pnpm --filter web run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm -r --filter=!@epgs/shared-types --filter=!@epgs/matching-engine run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm -r --filter=!@epgs/shared-types run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm -r --filter=!@epgs/shared-types --filter=!@epgs/matching-engine run typecheck
